## What we learned

Scientific calculators commonly use **EXP**, **EE**, or **×10ˣ** to enter the exponent in powers-of-10 notation.

For **4.7 × 10⁻⁶**:

1. enter **4.7**;
2. press the exponent key;
3. enter **−6**.

The exponent key already represents the **× 10ⁿ** part. Do not enter an extra **× 10** before using it. [[1, pp. 15–16]](../../references.qmd#ref-grob2016)

Calculator displays vary. Check the coefficient, exponent, sign, and whether the size of the answer makes sense.
